name: Keri Thompson
prior_offices: Niobrara County treasurer (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Keri Thompson is the Niobrara County treasurer and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official treasurer page lists her in that office, and the official general election summary lists her with 886 votes.
